correctness.rationale: The exact integer identities 2ta-(t-1)=u(tn-t+1), 8ta-M=e(2tn-3t+2), and e=2u+t bound pair gcds by M and give gcd(u,e)=1. For n>12M, e/a<1/M, so every symmetric gluing with pair gcd d<=M would have coefficient sum exactly d and hence e|d, contradicting e>M. The triangular branch has explicit coprime gluings and exact Frobenius formulas; finite verifier checked arithmetic and Apéry examples.
